review.root: Reviewed complete existing-pin production changes and all ten tests, finite exact original custody and atomic existing-only commit; authored and reviewed optional topology/packed embedding changes and three new tests plus updated old expectations. Accepted exact independent reviews. Reviewed complete frozen Qwen factory/test/doc package against actual shared equations and source/readout contracts; verified outer state length assertion and physical Sequence preservation. Combining disjoint source changes for one shared validation cycle. Corrected the new empty-collection assertion to is_empty() after compiler ambiguity between i32 and serde_json equality; no behavioral assertion changed. Added explicit child path for bounded_pins under the existing explicitly located retention test module; test source and behavior unchanged. Read and applied shared outer effective production repair: actual post-intervention emission, prepared retained paths and capacity, legacy parity, real failure/loan behavior. Qwen observer/assertions are unchanged; fake effective-observer draft is superseded and unapplied. Reviewed and applied matching custom local/parallel executor callback repair and new actual-adapter once-only nonzero parity test, preserving custom boundary ownership. Corrected the intervention test to replace the final execution group input: the underlying multi-root fixture deliberately requires exact root dependency markers. Added an exact final output assertion proving the replacement is consumed, retaining all original/effective ordering and traversal parity checks. Updated the existing strict V4 plain-custom-executor test to require each actual effective boundary and compare it exactly with its unchanged original; strict duplicate detection remains active. The old assertion explicitly encoded absence of the newly implemented shared effective callbacks. Reviewed all six discovery repair files and three new catalog tests: same existing shared original/effective declaration helper, identical axes and phase requirements, no second mutable target, Muse duplicate augmentation removed and V4 stream override preserved. Updated logical Nanbeige node expectation; strict numeric catalog emission oracle remains unchanged. Corrected the existing Nanbeige capture-selection fixture to derive the explicit unit Output path from its declared logical layer index and require node membership, replacing positional observation_paths[1]. The strict complete-catalog checks and all numerical/identity assertions remain unchanged. Reviewed full shared partition outer-boundary repair and two nonzero prepared tests across resident/host/disk and TP/PP combinations. Four traversal-owned architecture calls use the existing original/intervene/effective helper; owned boundaries retain suppression. Narrow public helper visibility allows reuse across the existing crate boundary. New tests require actual consumed replacements, once-only callback order, original typed effective-input failure before state and ordinary recovery. Legacy partition path formatting remains its existing obligation; no managed gate changes. Reviewed exact scalar resident abort override against the active-loan guard and both production resident policies. Only the synchronous fixture restores its acquired resident unit; original failure/state/order and healthy retry assertions remain unchanged.

behavior: Finite typed pin rows bind the actual immutable prefill schedule before original admission; all row controls are included once in the original protected hold.
One consuming owner yields one bank. Each canonical row issues one terminal attempt with fixed buffers; retries, errors and panic cannot replace or refund it.
Existing-key capacity/origin checks complete before owner increments; ordinal-only mutation invokes no provider comparator or destructor. Escaped and failed groups retain original custody.
Absent optional modules contribute zero for their actual selected topology; present unknowns, arithmetic overflow and explicit future native fields keep their original semantics.
Quantized embedding inspection includes its actual packed array, counts duplicate physical visits conservatively, and preserves distinct backing deduplication and logical parameter topology.
family_declarations: QwenBlockFactory and RoutedQwenBlockFactory use the existing common causal-row declaration mechanism; nonzero full/chunk comparisons cover cached prefix, uneven chunks, all declared hooks, repeated decode and physical Sequence readout selection.
limits: No native fixed collector or new capture-source publication bridge is activated by this change.
Provider-owned key heap allocations, enclosing prediction/media/sampler resources, paged growth/acquisition and physical source changes still need their own exact original coverage.
Count facts are bound to actual topology; they do not authenticate later mutation or replacement.
No new released-checkpoint or native multirank execution; neutral conformance and native singleton fixtures cover narrower behavior.
